constellations.desc: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
constellations.name: Somber Freeze

constellations.desc: The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an <color=#FFD780FF>ice crystal</color> fired by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color>.\nAdditionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.
constellations.name: Frostfall Reverberation

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Glacial Shard

constellations.desc: The duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> created by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> is increased by 25%.
constellations.name: Enduring Ice

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Bittercold Fog

constellations.desc: Every stack of {LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostglow</color>{/LINK} consumed when using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. A maximum 40% increase can be obtained in this way.
constellations.name: Brumal Grimfrost

passives.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> is on the field, DMG from the Traveler's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion, and DMG dealt is also increased by 80% of the Traveler's ATK.
passives.name: Ever-Keen Frost

passives.desc: The Traveler's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of their ATK. Up to 160 Elemental Mastery can be gained in this way.
passives.name: Lucent Ice

passives.desc: The Traveler will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when inside a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.\nWhen a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.35% for every 100 points of the Traveler's ATK. A maximum 7% increase can be obtained in this way.
passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Illusory Frostmirror

passives.desc:
Draws new strength and power from their past travels: Every Elemental Type the Traveler has resonated with now grants an additional {LINK#N10050001}<color=#FFD780FF>enhancement effect</color>{/LINK}.

Additionally, when a nearby party member deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG, the Traveler gains 1 stack of "Icepoint." 1 stack of Icepoint can be obtained in this way once every 2s, max 3 stacks. When the Traveler unleashes a Charged Attack at 3 stacks of Icepoint, all stacks are consumed to change the attack into a special <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color>
· <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> dealt is increased by 140% of the Traveler's ATK, and the Traveler also gains 2 stacks of {LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostglow</color>{/LINK}.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color> can be unleashed once every 15s. Additionally, the DMG Bonus from the Ascension Talent "Ever-Keen Frost" does not apply to <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer{/LINK}</color>: DMG from <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color> is instead considered <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.
passives.name: Foreign Permafrost

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Foreign Frostglint

skills.desc: Stabs at the opponent with the Traveler's weapon, which releases an ice-cold fog. This deals Cryo DMG to opponents up ahead and forms a Frostpierce Star next to the Traveler. Frostpierce Star · Follows your party members around the field and periodically fires ice crystals at nearby opponents, dealing Cryo DMG. Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Frostpierce Star will no longer fire ice crystals at opponents at intervals but will instead fire an ice crystal at opponents in a coordinated attack when the Traveler hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s. · When an opponent is hit with an ice crystal, the Traveler gains 1 stack of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} (max 8 stacks). · When not in combat, {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} expires after 30s. You observed the formation of frost together with Paimon.
skills.name: Ice Fog Piercer

skills.desc: Generates ice javelins with the power of Cryo, then directs them at the enemy to deal multiple instances of Cryo DMG. When cast, the Traveler consumes all existing stacks of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK}, which in turn increases the DMG dealt by this Elemental Burst. When 8 stacks of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} are consumed, the number of DMG instances caused by the javelins is also increased. {LINK#N11500004}Radiance: Stellar Glimmer{/LINK}: DMG from the current Elemental Burst is changed to Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type. You felt the keen edge of the icicles alongside Paimon.
skills.name: Frostbound Javelin

hyperlinks.description:
The Traveler gains an attribute bonus for every element they have resonated with: 
Anemo: CRIT Rate is increased by 10%,
Geo: DEF is increased by 20%,
Electro: Energy Recharge is increased by 20%, 
Dendro: Elemental Mastery is increased by 60,
Hydro: HP is increased by 20%,
Pyro: ATK is increased by 20%,
Cryo: CRIT DMG is increased by 20%.
hyperlinks.name: Additional Buff Effects

hyperlinks.description: The following special effect is granted when an ice crystal from a Frostpierce Star generated by the Traveler hits an opponent, or when the Traveler unleashes a Charged Attack: Freezing Ice after unlocking the Talent Deep Ice From Afar. Max 8 stacks.\nUnleashing the Elemental Burst Frostbound Javelin consumes all of the Traveler's Frostglow stacks to increase the DMG dealt by the current Elemental Burst. If 8 stacks are consumed, the number of strikes in the Elemental Burst is also increased.
hyperlinks.name: Frostglow

hyperlinks.description: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct and Radiance: Stellar Swirl are both considered Radiance: Stellar Glimmer states.\nCharacters can only be affected by one Radiance state at any one time, and where more than one state can be triggered, Radiance: Stellar-Conduct shall apply first.
hyperlinks.name: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer

info.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.
info.name: Traveler

const1.description: 旅行者造成了星烁反应伤害时，将为自身恢复5点元素能量，此效果至多每0.5秒触发1次。
const1.name: 渐肃的凝冰

const2.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}冰雾剑{/LINK}</color>发射的<color=#FFD780FF>冰晶</color>命中敌人后，还会使当前场上角色的元素精通提升60点，持续5秒。\n此外，若受到上述效果影响的角色触发了星烁反应，或造成了星烁反应伤害，则持续时间内，上述效果改为提升120点元素精通。
const2.name: 嗡鸣的陨冰

const3.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}聚冰成锋{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const3.name: 断金的锐冰

const4.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}冰雾剑{/LINK}</color>创造的<color=#FFD780FF>栗烈寒星</color>存在时间延长25%。
const4.name: 不化的顽冰

const5.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}冰雾剑{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 深寒的雾冰

const6.description: 施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}聚冰成锋{/LINK}</color>时，每消耗1层{LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>寒辉</color>{/LINK}，队伍中其他角色造成的星烁反应伤害提升5%，至多通过这种方式提升40%，持续15秒。
const6.name: 肃杀的熙冰

hyperlinks.description:
每与一种元素进行过共鸣，旅行者便会获得对应的属性提升：
风元素：暴击率提升10%；
岩元素：防御力提升20%；
雷元素：元素充能效率提升20%；
草元素：元素精通提升60点；
水元素：生命值提升20%；
火元素：攻击力提升20%；
冰元素：暴击伤害提升20%。
hyperlinks.name: 额外强化效果

hyperlinks.description: 旅行者凝结的栗烈寒星发射冰晶命中敌人时，或解锁天赋异邦的层冰后进行重击·冰凝后，将会获得的特殊效果。该效果至多叠加8层。\n施放元素爆发聚冰成锋时，旅行者会消耗所有的寒辉层数，提升本次元素爆发造成的伤害。若消耗层数为8层，则还会提升本次元素爆发造成伤害的段数。
hyperlinks.name: 寒辉

hyperlinks.description: 触发星超导反应时，附近的区域会短暂变化为极星辉域；处于极星辉域中时，特定角色将会进入辉映·星超导状态，使其不同技能分别获得对应的强化效果。
hyperlinks.name: 极星辉域

hyperlinks.description: 辉映·星超导与辉映·星扩散统称为辉映·星烁状态。\n角色同时只能受到一种辉映状态影响，且优先被辉映·星超导影响。
hyperlinks.name: 辉映·星烁

info.description: 从世界之外漂流而来的旅行者，被神带走血亲，自此踏上寻找七神之路。
info.name: 旅行者

p1.description: <color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>栗烈寒星</color>存在期间，旅行者的普通攻击、重击、下落攻击将转为造成无法被附魔覆盖的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>，且造成的伤害提升，提升值相当于旅行者攻击力的80%。
p1.name: 自锐的凛冰

p2.description: 旅行者的元素精通提升，提升值相当于旅行者攻击力的8%。通过这种方式，至多使旅行者的元素精通提升160点。
p2.name: 通明的冽冰

p3.description: 处于{LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>极星辉域</color>{/LINK}中时/队伍中的角色在附近触发星扩散反应后的8秒内，旅行者将分别进入<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>/<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>状态。\n队伍中的角色触发超导/冰元素扩散反应时，将转为触发星超导/星扩散反应，且基于旅行者的攻击力，提升队伍中角色造成的上述反应的基础伤害：每100点攻击力都将提升0.35%上述反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升7%伤害。
p3.name: 星耀祝礼·幻变冰镜

p4.description:
从过往的旅途中，汲取全新的力量。每与一种元素进行过共鸣，便会获得额外的{LINK#N10050001}<color=#FFD780FF>强化效果</color>{/LINK}。

此外，队伍中附近的角色造成星超导反应伤害或星扩散反应伤害时，旅行者将获得一层「凝冰之刃」，每2秒至多通过此方式获得1层「凝冰之刃」，至多叠加3层。拥有3层「凝冰之刃」时进行重击，会消耗所有的「凝冰之刃」，转为进行特殊的<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>
·将造成伤害更高的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>，伤害提升相当于旅行者攻击力的140%，并使旅行者获得2层{LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>寒辉</color>{/LINK}。
·每15秒至多进行一次<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>。此外，突破天赋「自锐的凛冰」的伤害加成效果对<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>无效。
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}：<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>改为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>。
p4.name: 异邦的层冰

elementalburst.description: 使用冰元素之力凝聚投矛，向敌人掷出，造成多次冰元素伤害。 施放时，旅行者会消耗所有{LINK#N10050002}寒辉{/LINK}层数，提升本次元素爆发造成的伤害；若消耗了8层寒辉，还会使投矛造成伤害的次数提升。 {LINK#N11500004}辉映·星烁{/LINK}：本次元素爆发改为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的冰元素伤害。 和派蒙一起感受过冰凌的锋利。
elementalburst.name: 聚冰成锋

elementalskill.description: 挥动武器向前刺击，释放极寒冰雾，对前方造成冰元素伤害，并在身旁凝结栗烈寒星。 栗烈寒星 ·将跟随队伍中自己的角色，并间歇性发射冰晶攻击附近的敌人，造成冰元素伤害。 辉映·星超导：栗烈寒星将不再间歇性发射冰晶，而是会在旅行者的普通攻击、重击或下落攻击命中敌人时，发射一枚冰晶，协同攻击敌人，每0.2秒最多触发一次。 ·冰晶命中敌人时，将为旅行者积攒1层{LINK#N10050002}寒辉{/LINK}，该效果至多积攒8层。 ·不处于战斗状态下时，寒辉将在30秒后清除。 和派蒙一起观察过雾凇的凝成。
elementalskill.name: 冰雾剑

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多五段的连续剑击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，瞬间向前方挥出两剑。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 异邦寒芒

constellations.desc: The Traveler regenerates 5 Elemental Energy when they deal Stellar Glimmer DMG. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
constellations.name: Somber Freeze

constellations.desc: The active character's Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 for 5s when an opponent is hit by an <color=#FFD780FF>ice crystal</color> fired by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color>.\nAdditionally, when a character affected by the aforementioned effect triggers a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, the Elemental Mastery boost described above will be increased to 120 for its duration.
constellations.name: Frostfall Reverberation

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Glacial Shard

constellations.desc: The duration of the <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> created by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> is increased by 25%.
constellations.name: Enduring Ice

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}Ice Fog Piercer{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Bittercold Fog

constellations.desc: Every stack of {LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostglow</color>{/LINK} consumed when using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}Frostbound Javelin{/LINK}</color> increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other party members by 5% for 15s. A maximum 40% increase can be obtained in this way.
constellations.name: Brumal Grimfrost

passives.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: When a <color=#FFD780FF>Frostpierce Star</color> is on the field, DMG from the Traveler's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion, and DMG dealt is also increased by 80% of the Traveler's ATK.
passives.name: Ever-Keen Frost

passives.desc: The Traveler's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of their ATK. Up to 160 Elemental Mastery can be gained in this way.
passives.name: Lucent Ice

passives.desc: The Traveler will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when inside a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.\nWhen a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.35% for every 100 points of the Traveler's ATK. A maximum 7% increase can be obtained in this way.
passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Illusory Frostmirror

passives.desc:
Draws new strength and power from their past travels: Every Elemental Type the Traveler has resonated with now grants an additional {LINK#N10050001}<color=#FFD780FF>enhancement effect</color>{/LINK}.

Additionally, when a nearby party member deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG, the Traveler gains 1 stack of "Icepoint." 1 stack of Icepoint can be obtained in this way once every 2s, max 3 stacks. When the Traveler unleashes a Charged Attack at 3 stacks of Icepoint, all stacks are consumed to change the attack into a special <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color>
· <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> dealt is increased by 140% of the Traveler's ATK, and the Traveler also gains 2 stacks of {LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>Frostglow</color>{/LINK}.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color> can be unleashed once every 15s. Additionally, the DMG Bonus from the Ascension Talent "Ever-Keen Frost" does not apply to <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer{/LINK}</color>: DMG from <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Freezing Ice</color> is instead considered <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.
passives.name: Foreign Permafrost

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Foreign Frostglint

skills.desc: Stabs at the opponent with the Traveler's weapon, which releases an ice-cold fog. This deals Cryo DMG to opponents up ahead and forms a Frostpierce Star next to the Traveler. Frostpierce Star · Follows your party members around the field and periodically fires ice crystals at nearby opponents, dealing Cryo DMG. Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Frostpierce Star will no longer fire ice crystals at opponents at intervals but will instead fire an ice crystal at opponents in a coordinated attack when the Traveler hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s. · When an opponent is hit with an ice crystal, the Traveler gains 1 stack of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} (max 8 stacks). · When not in combat, {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} expires after 30s. You observed the formation of frost together with Paimon.
skills.name: Ice Fog Piercer

skills.desc: Generates ice javelins with the power of Cryo, then directs them at the enemy to deal multiple instances of Cryo DMG. When cast, the Traveler consumes all existing stacks of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK}, which in turn increases the DMG dealt by this Elemental Burst. When 8 stacks of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} are consumed, the number of DMG instances caused by the javelins is also increased. {LINK#N11500004}Radiance: Stellar Glimmer{/LINK}: DMG from the current Elemental Burst is changed to Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type. You felt the keen edge of the icicles alongside Paimon.
skills.name: Frostbound Javelin

constellations.desc: 旅行者造成了星烁反应伤害时，将为自身恢复5点元素能量，此效果至多每0.5秒触发1次。
constellations.name: 渐肃的凝冰

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}冰雾剑{/LINK}</color>发射的<color=#FFD780FF>冰晶</color>命中敌人后，还会使当前场上角色的元素精通提升60点，持续5秒。\n此外，若受到上述效果影响的角色触发了星烁反应，或造成了星烁反应伤害，则持续时间内，上述效果改为提升120点元素精通。
constellations.name: 嗡鸣的陨冰

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}聚冰成锋{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 断金的锐冰

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}冰雾剑{/LINK}</color>创造的<color=#FFD780FF>栗烈寒星</color>存在时间延长25%。
constellations.name: 不化的顽冰

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10127}冰雾剑{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 深寒的雾冰

constellations.desc: 施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S10128}聚冰成锋{/LINK}</color>时，每消耗1层{LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>寒辉</color>{/LINK}，队伍中其他角色造成的星烁反应伤害提升5%，至多通过这种方式提升40%，持续15秒。
constellations.name: 肃杀的熙冰

passives.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>栗烈寒星</color>存在期间，旅行者的普通攻击、重击、下落攻击将转为造成无法被附魔覆盖的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>，且造成的伤害提升，提升值相当于旅行者攻击力的80%。
passives.name: 自锐的凛冰

passives.desc: 旅行者的元素精通提升，提升值相当于旅行者攻击力的8%。通过这种方式，至多使旅行者的元素精通提升160点。
passives.name: 通明的冽冰

passives.desc: 处于{LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>极星辉域</color>{/LINK}中时/队伍中的角色在附近触发星扩散反应后的8秒内，旅行者将分别进入<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>/<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>状态。\n队伍中的角色触发超导/冰元素扩散反应时，将转为触发星超导/星扩散反应，且基于旅行者的攻击力，提升队伍中角色造成的上述反应的基础伤害：每100点攻击力都将提升0.35%上述反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升7%伤害。
passives.name: 星耀祝礼·幻变冰镜

passives.desc:
从过往的旅途中，汲取全新的力量。每与一种元素进行过共鸣，便会获得额外的{LINK#N10050001}<color=#FFD780FF>强化效果</color>{/LINK}。

此外，队伍中附近的角色造成星超导反应伤害或星扩散反应伤害时，旅行者将获得一层「凝冰之刃」，每2秒至多通过此方式获得1层「凝冰之刃」，至多叠加3层。拥有3层「凝冰之刃」时进行重击，会消耗所有的「凝冰之刃」，转为进行特殊的<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>
·将造成伤害更高的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>，伤害提升相当于旅行者攻击力的140%，并使旅行者获得2层{LINK#N10050002}<color=#FFD780FF>寒辉</color>{/LINK}。
·每15秒至多进行一次<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>。此外，突破天赋「自锐的凛冰」的伤害加成效果对<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>无效。
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}：<color=#FFD780FF>重击·冰凝</color>改为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>。
passives.name: 异邦的层冰
